text:
An experiment is done to compare the rate of conduction of thermal energy in metal and plastic
spoons.
An ice cube is placed on one end of each spoon and the other end is heated gently.
ice cube
ice cube
metal spoon
plastic spoon
heat
heat
Which row has the correct prediction and correct explanation?
prediction
explanation
A
The ice cube would melt more quickly on the metal spoon.
Metal is a good conductor.
B
The ice cube would melt more quickly on the metal spoon.
Plastic is a good conductor.
C
The ice cube would melt more quickly on the plastic spoon.
Metal is a poor conductor.
D
The ice cube would melt more quickly on the plastic spoon.
Plastic is a poor conductor.

options.label: A
options.text: The ice cube would melt more quickly on the metal spoon. Metal is a good conductor.

options.label: C
